screening_note: Unverified forum account, paraphrased by the team (not the poster's words). Secondhand: the poster was not the pilot. Thread undated on the page; posted around late 2025.
synopsis: Forum user reported an M30T lost link that ended in an automatic return to home and safe landing.
narrative: A forum user described an M30T flight flown by a colleague. Without warning the aircraft entered return to home. The pilot could still see the live video but stick inputs had no effect, and the aircraft landed at its home point. The controller stayed on and the app did not appear to freeze. The flight log ended with strong uplink and downlink signals and no gradual signal drop. Replies suggested a sudden physical blockage of the controller signal or a human cause, but no cause was confirmed.

screening_note: Unverified forum account, paraphrased by the team. DJI's log analysis, as relayed by the poster, disagreed with the poster's account.
synopsis: Forum user reported an M30T lost control while landing on a boat and fell into the water.
narrative: On 11 August 2022 a pilot flying an M30T from an anchored boat in a canal tried to land on the deck. Instead of shutting down, the motors spun up, the aircraft lifted, tilted, struck the deck with its propellers, flipped and fell into the water, where it was not recovered. Just before control was lost the controller showed a satellite signal searching error and a fly-with-caution warning. A third party who reviewed the log thought a GPS fault triggered return to home. DJI's analysis, as relayed by the poster, said the aircraft was in GPS mode about 836 m from the home point and that a near-ground landing was triggered by the pilot's full-down throttle input. The poster disputed this.
